result.detail: The shipped configuration (recommended export plus HPO layers, 27,405 nodes / 151,231 edges) scores 0.4964 macro, 0.4543 micro and 0.3614 cold AUPRC against 0.4712/0.4033/0.2560 for the balanced reference, three seeds on the fixed held-out set. Cold seed spread is 0.0088, so the cold gain is about twelve times its noise.
